meta.quorumNote: Recommendation, not a ratified value. 10 of the 14 rows are tier-primary. 8 tolerates two simultaneous primary-source failures without letting a scan claim coverage it did not achieve. Failure is not hypothetical: on 2026-09-18 ai.meta.com/blog/ returned HTTP 400 to one User-Agent and HTTP 200 to another, and openai.com/news/ returned HTTP 403 to a direct GET while its RSS feed returned 200.
meta.coverageClaimNote: Earned only AFTER a scan completes with quorum.met === true. Until then releases-v1.json meta.coverageClaim stays "none". This set covers 12 named developers; several developers with published frontier models are absent (see the Coverage limits section of the companion document), so any page rendering the claim must render the provider list beside it.
